chapter.verse: Pasian’ deihna hangin Khazih Zeisu’ sawltak keimah Paul leh i sanggampa Timoti in Korin khua-ah a om Pasian’ pawlpi akipan Akhaia gam tengah a om misiangthote khempeuh thu kong zasak uh hi.
I Pa Pasian leh Topa Zeisu Khazih kiang panin hehpihna thupha leh nopna nomau tungah om ta hen.
Hehpihna Pa leh hehnepna apawl pawl khempeuh’ Pasian ahi, i Topa Zeisu Khazih’ Pa leh Pasian in thupha ngah ta hen.
Kote in Pasian’ hehpihna thupha hangah komau hehnepna hong piak mah bangin, gimna pawl khempeuh a thuakte a hehnem thei dingin gimna khempeuh sungah Pasian in kote hong hehnem hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih hanga gimna tampi ka thuak uh mah bangin Khazih hanga kote ngah hehnepna tampi a om hi.

Tua ahih ciangin kote in gimna ka thuak uh zongin note in hehnepna leh gupna na ngah nading uh ahi hi. Kote in hehnepna ka ngah uh zongin kote in gimna ka thuak uh zongin note in na thuak zawh nadingun hong bawlpha thei hehnepna na ngah nading uh ahi hi.
Note ading ka lametna uh a kip hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in gimna na hong thuak khawmpih uh mah bangin hehnepna zong nong ngah khawmpih ding uh hi ci-in ka thei uh hi.

Ute naute aw, Asia gamah kote in ka thuak uh gimna ahi nuntakna nangawn ka suakta zo kei ding uh hi ci-in um a, thuak zawh loh ding dongin a gik mahmah gimna ka thuak thu uh thei loin na om ding uh ka deih kei uh hi.
Kote in ka pumpi uh muang loin, misite a thosak Pasian muan nadingin sihna thukhenna a thuak mi bang ka hi uh hi.
Tua Pasian in tua zah-a lian sihna sung pan hong gumkhia a, hong gumkhia lai ding hi.

Note in hong huhin, kote ading thu hong ngetsak le-uh teh, tunung ciangin zong hong gum ding hi ci-in kote in umin ka muang uh hi. Tua ciangin kote tunga hong hehpihna hangin mi tampite’ lungdamkohna in kote hangin Pasian kiang a tung ding hi.

Kote kisaktheihna in leitung pilna suang loin, Pasian’ hehpihna thupha suangin Pasian hong piak lungsim siangthona leh dikna tawh, a lian belin gen lehang, kote in note lakah ahi zongin, leitungah ahi zongin gamta-in ka bawl uh hi ci-in ka theihna lungsim un teci hong pang hi.
Note in simin, na man’sate uh longal adang nate gelh-a hong pia ka hi kei uh hi.

Note in Topa Zeisu’ Ni ciangin kote kisaktheihna lungdamna na hih uh bangin kote in note kisaktheihna ka hi ding uh hi ci-in note in kote’ thu a cingin thei lo a, nong man’ uh mah bangin, a tawp dongin na mang ding uh hi, ci-in kote in lawpin ka om uh hi.
Tua bang lamenin ka om a, note in nih vei thupha na ngah nadingun note kiangah hong pai masa ning, ci-in ka lungngai hi.
Note kiang pan kileh kikin Makedonia gamah ka pai khit ciangin note kiangah hong pai kikin, Judah gam dongin note’ hong khakna thupha ka ngah ding ka geel hi.

Tua bang ka hanciam ciangin lungkheel mi ka hi hiam? Ahih kei leh, keima kamin, “Ahi hi, ahi hi,” ci ding ahi zongin, “Ahi kei hi, ahi kei hi,” ci ding ka hi zongin a suah nadingin ka hanciamnate in ci leh sa lungsim ahi hiam?
Pasian in dikna tawh a dim bangin note kiangah ka kam in, “Ahi hi,” ci ding ahi zongin, “Ahi kei hi,” ci ding ahi zongin ahi kei hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, keimah-a kipan Silvanas leh Timoti-te in note kiangah kong hilh uh Pasian’ Tapa Zeisu Khazih in, “Ahi hi,” ci ding ahi zongin, “Ahi kei hi,” ci ding ahi zongin ahi kei hi; “Ahi hi,” a cihna bek ahi den hi.
Thuciamnate in bang zahin a tam hangin Pasian’ minthan’na kilatsak nadingin, “Ahi hi,” cih ding ahi zongin, kote hangin, “Amen,” cih ding ahi zongin ahi hi.
Note tawh kote, Khazih sungah a hong kipsak, hong pahtawipa in Pasian ahi hi.
Tua Pasian in, eite Kha Siangtho sathau hong nilhin hong neihna ciamtehna hong khen-a, i lungsim sungah Kha Siangtho ahi kiciamna maleep hong guan’ hi.
Keimah in note ka hong dop manin Korin khua-ah ka hong pai kei ci-in ka lungsim ah teci dingin Pasian ka koih hi.
Tua bang ka cih ciangin kote in note’ upna uk ka hi kei uh hi. Note lungdam nading huhin nasemte bek ka hi uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, upna hangah note kipin na om uh hi.
